sights.n: Kirara Kujō Shopping Street (キララ九条商店街)
sights.address: Kujō, Nishi-ku, Osaka (west of Kujō Station)
sights.w: ~600 m covered arcade of ~150 shops running west from Kujō Station toward Kyocera Dome — a working downtown shōtengai with Orix Buffaloes game-day deals, the gateway to Kujō's 'curry battleground'.
